title: Dinner at nine o'clock!

before.predict: Look at the title. Does this family eat dinner early or late?

text.title: Monday, 9 October
paragraphs: Today is a normal Monday. I get up **early**, at half past six. I **always** have bread and tea for breakfast. My brother never eats breakfast — he says he is not hungry! He only drinks a glass of milk and runs to the bus.
School starts at eight. I come home at two o'clock and I do my homework. Then I help my mother in the kitchen. On Mondays I also have a music lesson at four o'clock.

In my family we eat **dinner** very **late**, at nine o'clock. My father works until eight, so we wait for him. We all eat **together** and we talk about our day. I like this time very much. My little cousin always falls asleep at the table!
After **dinner** I am very **tired**. I read for ten minutes and then I sleep. Tomorrow is Tuesday — I have English!
